qualified_claim: A fixed-capacity per-bin slot representation can impose a forcing-independent persistent-memory bound while exactly matching the unbounded reference topology on accepted no-overflow trials and conservatively failing closed on overflow.
hard_nonclaims: Eight slots are not shown sufficient for useful FWC coverage.
The 200-bin 41.6 kB persistent payload is not admitted as acceptable MultiSWAP memory cost.
Runtime work is not bounded under arbitrarily dense forcing events.
No physical FWC hydraulic equations or profile accuracy are qualified by A2.
No official M2WC70 code behavior is reproduced.
No MultiSWAP production admission follows from A2.

invariant_reconciliation.4_compact_persistent_state: Persistent allocation is fixed by template and does not grow with run history.
invariant_reconciliation.5_scratch_per_worker: Explicit-diffusion temporary arrays remain worker-owned scratch.
invariant_reconciliation.7_transactional_steps: Overflow trials do not mutate committed state or ledger.
invariant_reconciliation.13_mass_absolute: No water is clipped, merged or discarded to satisfy the capacity bound.
invariant_reconciliation.16_multiswap_primary: The representation is bounded, but the 200-bin payload cost remains unqualified for primary MultiSWAP.
invariant_reconciliation.24_predictable_runtime: Memory is bounded; event-rate runtime cost remains separately open.
invariant_reconciliation.30_explicit_qualification: The result separates bounded representation semantics from physical accuracy and runtime affordability.
